bio.text: Jermaine Johnson is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 52 (Kershaw and Richland counties), and the Democratic nominee for governor in the November 3, 2026 general election.
WRHI reported that he won his 2020 Democratic primary against a longtime incumbent; he is not seeking re-election to his House seat in order to focus on the governor's race.

According to his legislative biography, he holds a B.A. from the College of Charleston (2008) and is an adjunct professor at Webster University; WRHI reported that he played basketball at the College of Charleston.
